why.name: Experience
why.text: Founded in California in 1971, in the Las Vegas valley since 1991, and incorporated in Nevada in 1996.

why.name: Careful prep
why.text: Customers point to the prep work, the clean job sites and the care taken with furniture and carpet.

why.name: On time

reviews.text: Just wanted to share my thoughts re: my house recently being painted by Cal-Pac Painting.  I was incredibly pleased with the pricing, professionalism, their timeliness in execution and quality of their workmanship. They personally helped me narrow down the perfect paint color and it looks absolutely beautiful.
reviews.name: Lisa Stevens

reviews.text: All wood restoration, removal of old caulking, spackling and sanding were executed in a timely manner  with great expertise.  Any and all touch-up work was done immediately upon notice; and, there was never any griping or complaining from you or your men.
reviews.name: Gary S Marrone MD JD

reviews.text: I was amazed at how meticulous they were in the preparation and care in making that not a piece of furniture or carpet was harmed. Each room was painted exactly to my specifications.
reviews.name: Sharon Beesley

reviews.text: Evangelino was awesome and early, which is my favorite thing ever! The two rooms look fantastic! Thank you again!
